subject: Re: CodaHealth — request for staged pool increase and amendment
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@codahc.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity increase — Q3 spike + renewal coordination

Karthik,

Thanks for the renewal packet you sent last week. We're seeing a faster-than-expected adoption across our clinician note-generation flows and our SREs are asking for a short-term capacity plan. At a minimum we want to secure an additional 6 A100-equivalent GPUs for the remainder of our term (through Nov 2028), with an option to bring it to 12 by September if demand continues.

Two asks:
- Can you send a mid-contract amendment quote with options for staged increases (6 now, +6 in Sep)?
- We need a throughput commitment for the expanded pool (we're measuring in tokens/sec at 1k context and targeting sustained throughput of ~12k tokens/sec). If you can also include SLA language for tail latency (p99 < 350ms for single-turn inference) that would help our procurement team.

I've attached a short projection workbook. Also looped Elena (ops) — she'll own capacity numbers.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director of Platform Engineering
CodaHealth

Attachment: CodaHealth_Demand_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Park <daniel@codahc.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@codahc.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity increase — Q3 spike + renewal coordination

Daniel — thanks for the details and the workbook. Quick confirmation items before I produce formal amendment options:

- Do you want the additional capacity delivered as a single dedicated pool attached to your existing commit, or as a separate, time-bound addendum (we've done both; separate pool makes staged rollback easier).
- For throughput SLO: your 12k tokens/sec target at 1k context maps to roughly 6 concurrent streams on our current run profile; we can commit to a throughput SLO expressed as sustained tokens/sec per-pool, with automated scaling knobs subject to existing burst rules. I'll propose both a hard-guarantee and a best-effort option.
- Pricing: we can offer a mid-term add-on priced monthly as an incremental reserved GPU commitment. Ballpark discount range depends on term length — if you extend the overall contractual term to Feb 2029 we can stretch to a 16–20% effective discount on incremental units; for shorter window (through Nov 2028) it's closer to 8–12%.

I'll prepare two amendment drafts by tomorrow: (A) "Staged add-on" — 6 GPUs immediately, +6 on Sep 1, prorated billing; (B) "Single pool top-up" — immediate +12 with higher volume discount. Both will include throughput guardrails and a p99 latency credit schedule.

Looping Marissa for approval on concession bands.

—Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — separate pool is preferable (we want isolation across workloads during the ramp). A couple of clarifications:

- Proration: billing must be prorated to the day for the initial 6 GPUs; we'll accept monthly invoices if you provide prorated line items.
- SLA credits: procurement asked that p99 latency credits be capped (i.e., not full refunds for brief infra flaps). Can you provide a credit schedule like: 99.9% uptime (no credit), 99.0–99.9% (5% month credit), <99.0% (15% month credit). Similar for p99 latency breaches.
- Security: we're in a regulated environment — any amendment must reference our existing SOC2 addendum and note that logs for the dedicated pool retain 90 days by default.

I'll upload an updated workbook with daily delta forecasts this afternoon.

Elena
Head of SRE — CodaHealth

Elena / Daniel — attached is a draft amendment ("Draft_Amendment_RDW-5421.pdf") with two commercial options and the SLA/credit language you requested. Highlights:

Option 1 — Staged Pool (preferred by CodaHealth):
- 6 A100-equivalent GPUs added immediately as a separate reserved pool; +6 on Sep 1 if trigger thresholds met.
- Pricing: $64,800/mo for first 6 GPUs (effective unit rate $10,800/GPU/mo). Prorated daily billing for the first partial month.
- Discount: 10% off list on incremental units (applies only to the add-on portion).
- Throughput SLO: sustained 12k tokens/sec for the pool at 1k context; automated scaling excluded from SLO (scaling events won't count as breach).
- SLA credits: uptime and p99 latency schedule per your ask (5% / 15% bands).

Option 2 — Single Immediate Top-up:
- +12 GPUs immediately, consolidated into your primary pool; $120,000/mo, 15% discount on incremental units if the contract term is extended to Feb 2029.
- Faster provisioning, higher headroom for burst; requires an amendment to base commit.

Commercial notes / concessions asked internally:
- We can increase the discount to 12% on staged if you can commit to a minimum monthly spend threshold for the remainder of the term.
- We'll provide a one-time credit equal to unused prorated days on your existing burst capacity if you accept Option 2.

Next steps: if you prefer Option 1 I can create the formal DocuSign amendment and push a prorated invoice. If Option 2, we'll need internal legal approval for the term-extension concession — I have that queued with Marissa.

Attachments: Draft_Amendment_RDW-5421.pdf

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Stick to the uptime/p99 credit schedule Elena requested; legal will add a short clause limiting credits to direct monthly charges only.
- Ask CodaHealth to sign the amendment within 10 business days for the proposed pricing to hold. If they push beyond that, we revert to list incremental pricing + 5% uplift.

Please proceed to get formal signoff from Coda (DocuSign link in the amendment) and loop Jonas for billing activation once signed.
